## Reference Answer
You can use the YASB CLI to toggle widget visibility. The `toggle-widget` command allows you to show or hide specific widgets.

Example: `yasbc toggle-widget powermenu --follow-mouse`

The `--follow-mouse` option will toggle the widget on the screen where your mouse cursor is currently located. Alternatively, you can specify a particular monitor using `--screen <screen_name>`.
